title: Launch contingency orchestration and communication blueprint
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: Produce a single-source-of-truth blueprint that operationalizes launch contingencies for api-2026.03. Deliverables: 1) a compiled release-blocker checklist with clear triage thresholds and owners; 2) step-by-step rollback procedures for primary and fallback model routes; 3) templated incident communications for internal and customer-facing channels (Slack, status page, release notes); 4) cross-team rehearsal plan (playback + tabletop) and a post-launch retro trigger; 5) an agreed escalation matrix and cutover decision rubric. This ticket coordinates PM, Eng, Design, SRE, Legal, and Support for alignment and sign-off. The blueprint must link to the release notes draft and the runtime fallback config PRs so rollout coordinators can run the checklist during the release window.
